elements.label: Figure 6.12: Social assistance benefit levels in Vietnam compared to other countries
elements.description: Vertical bar chart. Y-axis: "Benefits as a share of welfare among the lowest quintile", scale 0 to 25 in steps of 5. X-axis categories: LIC, LMIC, UMIC, HIC, World, Vietnam. No values are printed on the bars; approximate readings: LIC ~13, LMIC ~18, UMIC ~22, HIC ~18, World ~19, Vietnam ~6. Source note: WB ASPIRE 2018; Dutta and Sen (2018). Excludes health waivers. Vietnam's bar is far lower than all comparator groups, while the other groups cluster between about 13 and 22.

elements.label: Figure B.6.3.1: Key Elements of Vietnam's Social Protection System
elements.description:
Organizational diagram. Top box: "Resolution 15 on Social Policies for 2012-2020", connected to a node labeled "Social Protection". Four branches below, each with vertical sub-boxes:
1. Social Assistance (teal): Regular Allowances; Social Care Centers and Care Services; Emergency Assistance.
2. Social Insurance (green): Unemployment Insurance; Compulsory and voluntary Insurance; Other Programs (Supplement SI).
3. Employment, Incomes and Poverty Reduction (orange): Public Works Training; Vocational Training; Other Productive Employment Programs.
4. Minimum Basic Social Services (grey): Housing; Health Insurance and Health; Education; Clean Water; Information Access.
Connectors run from the Social Protection node to each of the four branch headers.
